title: Turn a YouTube video into text
prompt: Extract https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=qDw3hWCxJtY into a readable transcript and timestamped JSON. Then draft a five-minute recap with source notes.
intro: The English transcript is ready: about 8,010 words and 441 timestamped segments.

blocks.name: script.txt + show-notes.md
blocks.detail: Original recap draft and source notes

blocks.text: The returned video ID matched the requested video. All 441 segments passed the structure check.

limits: This run extracted text and drafted a recap. It did not generate audio. The transcript may contain speech-recognition errors; source claims were not independently verified.
